sources.title: Hospital discharge summary
facts: The discharge summary records a three-day admission for shortness of breath, with discharge home on November 21.
The discharge medication list records lisinopril 10 mg once daily.
The discharge medication list records furosemide 20 mg once daily.
The discharge instructions request a primary care visit within seven days.

sources.title: Cardiology correspondence
facts: The cardiology letter lists lisinopril 20 mg once daily.
The cardiology letter requests a basic metabolic panel within one week.
The letter records a cardiology review following the hospital discharge.

sources.title: Basic metabolic panel
facts: Potassium was reported as 4.3 mmol/L on November 23.
Creatinine was reported as 1.04 mg/dL on November 23.

sources.title: Intake medication note
facts: The intake note records a patient-reported lisinopril dose of 10 mg once daily.
Patient reports a penicillin allergy with rash on the intake note.
The intake note records that the patient brought a medication bottle for verification.

sources.title: Primary care referral
facts: The referral requests endocrinology review after an outside hemoglobin A1c result.
The referral lists metformin 500 mg twice daily.
The referral requests a repeat urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio.

sources.title: Outside lab results
facts: Hemoglobin A1c was reported as 7.8% on November 21.
Creatinine was reported as 0.92 mg/dL on November 21.

sources.title: Endocrinology intake
facts: The endocrinology intake lists metformin 500 mg twice daily.
The intake note says the repeat urine albumin-to-creatinine result had not been received.
The intake note lists allergies as not yet reviewed.

sources.title: Pulmonology visit note
facts: The pulmonology visit documents a review of the patient’s inhaler list.
The pulmonology note lists budesonide-formoterol as two puffs twice daily.
The pulmonology note requests spirometry before the follow-up visit.

sources.title: Pharmacy medication list
facts: The pharmacy directions list budesonide-formoterol as one puff twice daily.
The pharmacy list also shows an albuterol inhaler with directions as needed.

sources.title: Scheduling callback
facts: The callback note records that the spirometry report is still pending.
The callback note records that the patient requested an afternoon follow-up slot.
